item.content:encoded:
A tale exploring the history of the Hanged King, with some references of SCP-2264. Art by me.

Huge thanks to TwistedGears who helped me correct the grammar mistakes, and Perelka_L, Roget, Decibelles and many others for reviewing the tale.

The white text between the peoms is there for format reasons, don't need to worry about it, but if anyone's interested:

+Rough translation of the white text
- which is there for format reasons

The crows cease their laughers
As the black stars shines
The so-called Hanged King
Moans and cries

His throne brings only torture
His crown resembles chains
Those not of the living
Serve along his side

The dresses bloom like flowers
And the feast is grand
The masks on their faces
Laugh or cry?

The building around the city
From dreams or nightmares?
A labyrinth with intricate paths
To lost and never return

The Kings and their subjects
Shocked at the city’s Grandness
The gods and the demons
Tremble before his might

Blood of the people
For the Hanged King to have
Blood of the Fool
Shall be served at the Court

The crows loudly laugh
The black stars dim in the sky
The so-called Hanged King
Pitiful and sad
